purpose: Establish social proof via customer-logo repetition

responsive.phone: Logo row scrolls/loops with default (untruncated) label text.
responsive.tablet: Outer padding narrows to a specific 79px value (tablet:px-[79px]); label centers and wraps to a fixed width instead of the phone's whitespace-pre flow (tablet:text-center tablet:w-auto tablet:whitespace-pre still applies -- i.e. the label itself doesn't wrap, but its container does).
responsive.desktop: Outer padding widens to px-40 (a wider gutter than tablet's 79px value); logo glyphs grow slightly (desktop:h-6).
